claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II mission is sending four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the moon.
Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
Artemis II is a 10-day mission to fly around the Moon (lunar flyby) and return to Earth.
Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket carried the Orion spacecraft from Launch Complex 39B.
NASA is preparing for Artemis III.
Artemis III plans to return humans to the lunar surface in 2027.
